issue: Fund-driver label 'new shorts' on the 27 Oct week where managed money added +1,538 longs and +182 shorts (net +1,356, price −1.64 %); the rule tests ΔS>0 before comparing magnitudes, so any down-week with one new short is 'new shorts'.
